annotation.audio: A short, upbeat chiptune-style music loop featuring a bright, arpeggiated synth melody, a simple bass line, and a steady electronic drum beat (kick, snare/clap, and hi-hat). The music is clean, digital, and looped, with no vocals or speech.
annotation.visual: A contact-sheet layout with three vertical columns of identical blue rectangular tiles, each separated by thin dark gray borders. Each tile contains white text showing a time label followed by a frame count in parentheses, such as '100s | 0.00s', '+0.33s | 0.33s', '+0.67s | 0.67s' in the top row; '+1.00s | 1.00s', '+1.33s | 1.33s', '+1.67s | 1.67s' in the middle row; and '+2.00s | 2.00s', '+2.33s | 2.33s', '+2.67s | 2.67s' in the bottom row. The background of the entire image is solid blue.
annotation.cross_modal: The music plays continuously throughout the image window; there is no speech, voice, or human action present in either the audio or the visual content.

observations.description: A continuous, cheerful chiptune music loop with no vocals or speech.
Three columns of blue tiles with white time/frame labels on dark borders, forming a contact sheet; no people, gestures, or actions appear.
No audio-visual cross-modal relationship exists; the music is purely auditory and the image is purely visual.
